title: Optimized Base64 file handling in Dynamics 365 Business Central 2026 Wave 1
summary: Dynamics 365 Business Central 2026 Wave 1 introduces a new platform codeunit for Base64 encoding and decoding that automatically improves performance and reduces memory usage without requiring code changes. Existing applications gain 30-45% better encoding and 15-25% better decoding performance, while developers can optionally refactor to use stream-based methods for further optimization.
key_points: New System.Runtime.Base64Convert codeunit (2000000024) provides optimized native Base64 methods with multiple overloads for streams and text
Automatic performance gains of 30-45% for encoding and 15-25% for decoding happen without refactoring existing code
Stream-based encoding/decoding methods offer optional optimization path for applications handling Base64 intensively
Platform includes telemetry warnings for strings exceeding 10MB to help identify refactoring opportunities

quotes.text: Bold move by Product Group in speeding up Base64 handling and making it more (memory) resource savvy.
quotes.why_it_matters: Summarizes the key benefit of automatic performance improvement without developer effort, addressing both speed and resource governance

quotes.text: there is no need for refactoring code to have this working in your application. It is just automatic.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies that existing code automatically benefits from improvements, lowering migration effort and risk
